technique_name: Describe how Machine Learning algorithms can lead to better decision making.
description: Machine learning algorithms can help to lead to better decision making by providing a more efficient and accurate understanding of data. By analyzing data and extracting patterns, machine learning algorithms can provide more accurate insights and predictions than traditional techniques. This means that decisions can be made more quickly and precisely, leading to improved accuracy and efficiency.
